title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25k Blue Razz Cherry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blue Razz Cherry brings together a tangy Blue Raspberry lead with a fuller Cherry backdrop for a vivid, fruit-driven taste. The sweet–tart balance keeps the profile lively and well defined. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, the pack combines a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can install both refills and switch at the device selector whenever you want a change. The integrated mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt deliver consistent MTL vapour, reliable flavour delivery and rapid nicotine relief. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
